issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'this one was born there' (זֶה יֻלַּד שָׁם), referring to Zion (implied by context, but the word 'there' is explicit). The Vietnamese adds 'tại Si-ôn' (in Zion), which is an addition not present in the Hebrew text. The Hebrew does not name Zion in this verse; it only says 'there'.
